main_body: A palm tree: a segmented brown trunk curving up to a drooping green frond canopy with two orange coconuts, drawn as a vertical organic silhouette.
top_band: none as a distinct horizontal surface; the canopy reads as drooping fronds (greens, rows ~1-14) seen from the side, with no separate flat top band above a front face
evidence: Reading a column through the middle: the green frond canopy sits at rows 2-12, then the trunk runs down in rows 12-37. This is a side-view palm silhouette. Fronds droop down both sides and the trunk is drawn as a vertical profile with no horizontal top surface. It reads as a side/front elevation of an organic plant rather than a 3/4 volume with a top and a front face. Being organic it is somewhat forgiving, but the canopy is not a top surface over a front face, so by the strict rule it fails.

style.evidence: The palm has about 4 green steps in the fronds (dark, mid, light, highlight) and 4 brown steps with ring segments in the trunk. Outlines are dark green and dark brown, tinted by the neighbouring material, with no black sticker line. The trunk has some ring texture, and the fronds have clump variation, but the fronds are sparse and thin and the drooping tips are single-pixel strands. Next to the dense, richly clumped reference canopies it carries fewer colours per tile and less leaf texture, so it is slightly lower in density and shallower in shading than the Beodeul standard.
